title: Listening Drill — Indoor rowing practice — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Indoor rowing practice — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on indoor rowing practice last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with uneven pace. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: slipping pedal.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of stroke rate so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow sports towel instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the rowing coach before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Sunday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
